status: Six original pending-media failures resolved; full file and expanded owner/security assertions pass. Production is unchanged. Phase 5/6/W26 remain open.

baseline.failure: Original line 40 expects one reservation but sees two. All later assertions in those six cases were unexecuted.

rootCause.mechanism: Raw IndexedJournalRequestSnapshot.create(pin) has no native lease or admission provenance. Its external resolver correctly reserves once. The old journal pin independently keeps the existing history owner alive through the durable release queue. Resolver release removes only its own claim. History release and reclamation must follow final source retirement.
rootCause.conclusion: The test predates pinned native ownership. The extra owner is legitimate for this external reader; there is no demonstrated purge-view admission-provenance regression to repair. Exact owner sets, independent release phases, native zero-reservation cases and negative controls replace the stale predicate. No count was merely raised from one to two.

finalRegression.tokens: Instance tokens are validated but not emitted.

provenance.assertions: Actual reservation filenames prove the admission claim before and after the codec/resolver. Caller clones reserve externally while admission remains live. After admission release, the source stays open and an independent owner keeps the blob alive: the former admitted reference must reserve externally, not read under dead authority. After the independent owner releases, janitor removes the blob and resolution rejects with blob-verification context.
referenceFlow: MediaAdmissionService captures an admitted source under its exact reservation owner.
JournalTailSource.tailRow stores per-pending-block source capability alongside encoded bytes, not historical rows.
IndexedJournalRequestSnapshot.captureMedia calls captureAdmission at the original block position after normalization; stored historical references enter the request WeakSet.
PinnedHistoryMediaLease requires the actual store, weak reference membership and live reader scope. It is the current class name, not SourceNativeMediaLease.

RequestMediaResolver selects live admission, authorized historical pin or verified external reservation. LocalMediaStore.release closes admission sources for that exact owner/content pair before releasing persistence.
